c3-col-0002: Paul says principalities and powers were created through Him and for Him. Let's read Colossians 1:16 and 2:15.
c3-col-0003: Paul says that in Him everything holds together. Let's read Colossians 1:17 and 3:11.
c3-col-0004: Paul urges believers to continue, grounded and steadfast. Let's read Colossians 1:23 and 2:5.
c1-1th-0001: Others were telling how the Thessalonians turned to God. Let's read First Thessalonians 1:9.
c2-1th-0001: Paul looks back on his time with the Thessalonians. Let's read First Thessalonians 2:7 together.
c2-1th-0002: Paul longed with great desire to see the Thessalonians again. Let's read First Thessalonians 2:17-18.
c2-1th-0003: Paul wonders what thanks he can give God for all his joy over them. Let's read First Thessalonians 3:9-10.
c3-1th-0001: Paul writes about those who sleep in Jesus. Let's read First Thessalonians 4:13-14.
c3-1th-0002: Paul prays that the Lord would make them abound in love to one another. Let's read First Thessalonians 3:12 and 4:9.
c3-1th-0003: Paul says Jesus delivers us from the wrath to come. Let's read First Thessalonians 1:10 and 5:9.
c3-1th-0004: Paul urges believers to walk worthy of God. Let's read First Thessalonians 2:12 and 4:12.
c1-2th-0001: Paul repeats a command he gave while he was with them. Let's read Second Thessalonians 3:10.
c2-2th-0001: Paul closes with a greeting in his own hand. Let's read Second Thessalonians 3:17 together.
c2-2th-0002: Paul asks them not to be soon shaken in mind or troubled. Let's read Second Thessalonians 2:1-2.
c2-2th-0003: Paul writes about someone who does not obey the word in his letter. Let's read Second Thessalonians 3:14-15.
c3-2th-0001: Paul wanted to make himself an example for them to follow. Let's read Second Thessalonians 3:8-9.
c3-2th-0002: Paul prays that the Lord of peace would give them peace always. Let's read Second Thessalonians 2:16 and 3:16.
c3-2th-0003: Paul says they suffer so they may be counted worthy of God's kingdom. Let's read Second Thessalonians 1:5 and 2:14.
c3-2th-0004: Paul tells the Thessalonians that he prays for them always. Let's read Second Thessalonians 1:11 and 3:1.
c1-1ti-0001: Paul shares a faithful saying, worthy of all acceptance. Let's read First Timothy 1:15.
c2-1ti-0001: Paul encourages Timothy, his son in the faith. Let's read First Timothy 4:12 together.
c2-1ti-0002: Paul writes about caring for family at home. Let's read First Timothy 5:4 and 5:8.
c2-1ti-0003: Paul reminds Timothy that we brought nothing into this world. Let's read First Timothy 6:6-7.
c3-1ti-0001: Paul tells Timothy to give attention to reading, exhortation, and doctrine. Let's read First Timothy 4:13 and 4:15.
c3-1ti-0002: Paul charges Timothy to fight the fight of faith. Let's read First Timothy 1:19 and 6:12.
c3-1ti-0003: Paul says we trust in the living God, the Savior of all men. Let's read First Timothy 3:15 and 4:10.
c3-1ti-0004: Paul remembers the prophecies made about Timothy. Let's read First Timothy 1:18 and 4:14.
c1-tit-0001: Paul left Titus behind to set things in order and appoint elders. Let's read Titus 1:5.
c2-tit-0001: Paul planned to send Artemas or Tychicus to Titus. Let's read Titus 3:12 together.
c2-tit-0002: Paul asks Titus to be a pattern of good works. Let's read Titus 2:7-8.
c2-tit-0003: Paul tells Titus to avoid foolish disputes. Let's read Titus 3:9-10.
c3-tit-0001: Paul says He gave Himself to redeem us from every lawless deed. Let's read Titus 2:13-14.
c3-tit-0002: Paul says the grace and kindness of God our Savior have appeared. Let's read Titus 2:11 and 3:4-5.
c3-tit-0003: Paul speaks of becoming heirs, justified by His grace. Let's read Titus 1:2 and 3:7.
c3-tit-0004: Paul calls Titus a true son in their common faith. Let's read Titus 1:4 and 2:15.
c1-2pe-0001: Peter writes that the Lord had shown him something about what was ahead. Let's read Second Peter 1:14.
c2-2pe-0001: Peter remembers the Father speaking to honor Jesus. Let's read Second Peter 1:17 together.
c2-2pe-0002: Peter calls false teachers wells without water. Let's read Second Peter 2:17 and 2:19.
c2-2pe-0003: Peter warns that scoffers will come in the last days. Let's read Second Peter 3:3-4.
c3-2pe-0001: Peter says those who do these things will never stumble. Let's read Second Peter 1:9-10.
c3-2pe-0002: Peter thinks it right to stir up his readers by reminding them. Let's read Second Peter 1:13 and 3:1.
c3-2pe-0003: Peter warns that false teachers will secretly bring in destructive heresies. Let's read Second Peter 2:1 and 3:17.
c3-2pe-0004: Peter warns that false teachers will use deceptive words. Let's read Second Peter 1:16 and 2:3.
